verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is Track Changes, which extracts redlines and comments from PDFs and scans, so annotations on scanned documents are partly covered. Structured extraction fills a JSON schema and cites source bounding boxes, which supports auditing but is not confidence flagging. Missing for 10: any explicit handwriting recognition claim, per-field confidence scores or uncertainty flags, handwritten form-field extraction docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration on handwritten inputs.
